title: Fail-closed trusted Attestor v4 preflight and concurrent R7 Production diagnostics

phases.objective: Reject obsolete candidate-only backend attestation before mutating trusted GitHub statuses and retain concurrent runtime-environment and signed-ingress blockers in GET-only R7 output.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only a verified, authenticated, nonmutating v4 capability response supporting main exact-HEAD status can precede a governed attestation POST; v3 or missing capability fails closed.
steps: Resolve exact source/base/candidate evidence and owner attestation
Issue read-only authenticated v4 capability probe before any attestation POST
Reject missing, legacy or malformed capability without publishing status
Keep original same-cycle status ID and creator readbacks as mandatory acceptance checks
assertions: The probe is before the mutating policy-controller POST
The capability must confirm main HEAD status support, installed GitHub App provider and nonmutating mode
No secrets or raw authenticated responses enter logs

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: R7 reports absent runtime_environment and TRUSTED_INGRESS_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED concurrently without masking either behind a primary classification or claiming a SHA mismatch.
steps: Preserve public GET-only and bounded redacted header capture
Record identity HTTP success and canonical branch/SHA independently
Return a bounded machine-readable list of simultaneous readiness blockers
Never assert Production current while required OAuth metadata or runtime environment identity is absent
assertions: Simultaneous blockers are represented when both missing environment metadata and signed trusted ingress exist
HTTP 429 remains not proof of SHA mismatch
No hosting/Cloudflare/database/secret or protected branch mutation

phases.objective: Separate Production activation: audited runtime deployment exposing runtime_environment, signed Hostinger/Cloudflare trusted ingress, GitHub Ruleset/App required-check reconciliation, rollback proof and independent release authority.
blockers: Production ref/runtime deployment not authorized by this PR
Canonical GitHub App binding and server ruleset policy drift remain unresolved
Production signed ingress configuration and origin proof require independently authorized operations
